study.title: Antitumor Effects and the Potential Mechanism of 10-HDA against SU-DHL-2 Cells

existing_appraisal_check.scope: decisions.json and existing primary qualification/review Markdown
existing_appraisal_check.result: No matching 10-HDA/PMID39204193 appraisal found; not a claim that the source was absent from prior abstract ledgers.

compound_identity.preparation: Named compound, 50 mg dissolved in 100 µL anhydrous ethanol, diluted in culture medium; not an administered royal-jelly mixture.
compound_identity.structure_scope: Figure1 depicts the unsaturated hydroxylated C10 acid; reagent supplier, catalogue, lot, purity and independent structural/batch authentication are not specified in the read main paper.
compound_identity.identity_limit: No CAS/isomer or commercial-product equivalence inferred from a name or the association with royal jelly.
compound_identity.common_availability: Royal-jelly association is a natural-source description; this task did not establish current product stock, human exposure, efficacy or safety.

study_arms.source: Reported ATCC CRL-2956, purchased from Cellcook, Guangzhou
study_arms.controls: 0.02%ethanol in complete culture medium; no standard antitumor positive control.
study_arms.endpoint: CCK-8 OD450-derived reduction in viability/metabolic signal, labeled cell death by authors.
CCK-8; signal rises at200-600 and falls at800-1000; reported IC50 approximately1000µg/mL.
study_arms.normal_cell_claim: Cannot establish a normal-hepatocyte window: Cellosaurus CVCL_6926 identifies L-02/LO2 as a contaminated HeLa derivative (ICLAC-00575). Study stock STR/authentication not supplied.

study_arms.model: HSF, described as normal human fibroblasts
study_arms.endpoint: Smaller CCK-8 changes than SU-DHL-2; no50%inhibition reached in displayed range; authors report IC50>1000µg/mL.
study_arms.controls_limit: Generic HSF identity, donor/source and stock-authentication details are not supplied; comparator remains useful at stated scope.
study_arms.statistics: Reported overall F(5,12)=2.473,p=.0923, while Figure2C marks1000µg/mL with an asterisk.

study_arms.intervention: 496.8µg/mL10-HDA versus0.02%ethanol control for24h in proteomics; RT-PCR treatment/control ratio in same study context
study_arms.endpoint: Label-free proteomics, exploratory enrichment/network analysis and selected-gene RT-PCR.
study_arms.timing_limit: RT-PCR subsection does not independently restate its dose/time; IC50 context is explicit for proteomics and inferred study context only for the gene panel.

BUB1B_evidence.assay: Selected-gene RT-PCR, beta-actin reference; Table3 lists BUB1B primers, Figure6 shows expression<1.
BUB1B_evidence.statistical_note: No exact numerical fold or BUB1B-specific P/FDR displayed; Figure6 lacks gene-specific significance markers. No digitized estimate assigned.
BUB1B_evidence.protein_direction: Unqualified. No BUBR1-specific quantitative protein result or orthogonal Western assay is supplied in the read main material; authors explicitly note noncorrespondence of selected RNA/protein directions.
BUB1B_evidence.target_claim: No10-HDA-BUBR1 binding, occupancy or BUB1B-dependent genetic rescue/epistasis demonstrated.
BUB1B_evidence.functional_limit: No checkpoint, chromosome-fidelity, productive-renewal or useful-muscle endpoint.

positive_and_null_findings.credit: Actual named-compound cell-assay positive, not animal tumor response or clinical benefit.

positive_and_null_findings.finding: No significant difference reported between the higher750 and1000µg/mL groups
positive_and_null_findings.limit: Figure2A labels the former800, so the exact higher-dose identity is unresolved.

positive_and_null_findings.finding: HSF responds less strongly and does not reach50%inhibition in plotted range
positive_and_null_findings.credit: Comparator finding preserved without a broad normal-cell safety/selectivity claim.

positive_and_null_findings.finding: LO2 shows increased CCK-8 signal at lower doses and stronger suppression at higher doses
positive_and_null_findings.limit: Not verified proliferation or normal liver repair; LO2 identity precludes normal-hepatocyte inference.

positive_and_null_findings.finding: 147 proteins up,347 down,3405not significantly changed by stated proteomics criteria; complement/coagulation enrichment adjustedP=.0124
positive_and_null_findings.limit: The pathway value is not a BUB1B P value or causal target validation; other displayed pathways fail adjusted significance.
No successful in-vivo treatment efficacy. Failed model establishment is not evidence of an ineffective administered regimen.

positive_and_null_findings.finding: Royal jelly/10-HDA plus R-CHOP is suggested in discussion
positive_and_null_findings.limit: No such combination arm, synergy test or patient treatment was performed in this study.

experimental_and_statistical_units.replication: All experiments stated to be in triplicate; mean±SEM. Independent cultures versus technical wells and proteomics biological-preparation units not resolved. Individual cells are not independent n.
experimental_and_statistical_units.cell_statistics: Arcsine-square-root-transformed OD-derived percentages analyzed by ANOVA; post hoc details/exact contrasts are not fully supplied.
experimental_and_statistical_units.proteomics: Identification FDR≤1% and ≥1unique peptide; expression testing uses t-tests with nominalp≤.05 andFC≥2or≤.5. Identification FDR is not an expression multiple-testing correction.
experimental_and_statistical_units.gene_panel: RT-PCR treatment/control ratios, beta-actin normalization; no BUB1B-specific significance or usable raw table.
experimental_and_statistical_units.data_availability: Article states data contained within article; no proteomics accession or raw-data reproduction claimed.

source_issues.reported: 50mg/100µL ethanol stock;0.02%ethanol called equal to the1000µg/mL drug condition.
source_issues.calculation: The reported stock is500mg/mL; dilution to1mg/mL implies0.2%v/vethanol, tenfold the stated0.02%.
source_issues.interpretation: Unresolved documentation/procedure discrepancy; do not silently repair the dose or claim the observed effect was caused by ethanol.

source_issues.reported: Text calls250µg/mL significant, but Figure2A shows no asterisk on250; stars appear at500,800,1000.
Overall ANOVA p=.0923 versus asterisk at1000µg/mL in Figure2C.
source_issues.interpretation: Different contrasts might be involved, but they are not adequately specified. Do not declare all doses nontoxic or erase the upper-dose signal.

source_issues.reported: The death percentage is calculated from CCK-8 OD450, with negative values in some comparators.
source_issues.interpretation: It is a metabolic/viability-assay change, not direct dead-cell counting, apoptosis confirmation or proliferation rate. No cell-free assay-interference control described.

control_authenticity.status: HeLa derivative; ICLAC-00575; originally misidentified as normal fetal liver
control_authenticity.scope: Official identity registry checked; no new authentication of the authors actual vial or full rereading of the2015 authentication primary.

competitive_disposition.disposition: Retain in-vitro lymphoma viability comparator; deprioritize the present evidence as a BUBR1-restoration or muscle-compensation lead.
competitive_disposition.reason: Actual cell suppression and BUB1B RNA lowering deserve credit at their assay/model scope. They do not supply restoration of the relevant protein or useful muscle output; the comparator and solvent/reporting limits materially constrain selectivity and exposure claims.
competitive_disposition.equal_standards: A different model is not itself disqualifying; niacin and apitegromab also lack established MVA rescue. The current10-HDA result points toward cancer-cell suppression/RNA decrease, whereas niacin has a separate cross-intervention restoration rationale and apitegromab has clinical motor-function evidence in another disease. No comparative MVA efficacy or superiority is inferred.
competitive_disposition.normal_MVA_harm: Not demonstrated; cancer-cell RNA decrease cannot establish normal-MVA harm.
competitive_disposition.royal_jelly_equivalence: Not established; no royal-jelly mixture efficacy, safety, intake or human regimen inferred.
